stories.headline: Singapore sees 65% decline in cervical cancer mortality rate since 1990, but screening gaps remain
stories.what_happened: Cervical cancer remains one of the few cancers that can potentially be eliminated through human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination, regular screening and timely treatment of precancerous changes.
